stages.prompt: Surgical edit of the FIRST attached image: the existing Ciel happy face material composition. SECOND image is the approved happy expression target, use its joyful softness. Keep FIRST image's exact square crop, white hair strands, occlusion, brow positions, nose, face silhouette, porcelain skin, neck and collar. Keep the small pink smiling mouth EXACTLY unchanged. Improve ONLY the closed smiling eyes and blush: restore a little more rounded upward arch and center thickness to both closed lashes so the cheek/lower eyelid seems gently lifted, keeping both ends finely tapered and the same lash width and location. Retain 2-3 tiny white lash glints. Do not make flat black bars or sharply angular eyebrows. It should read as joyful lifted cheeks matching the SECOND reference, not just separate decorative eye symbols. Do not alter head/face proportions or move mouth. No text. One same-framing square edited face.
